draft.text: I’m pleased to announce the release of *From Token to Fleet*, a technical guide on scaling LLM systems from individual token processing to distributed GPU clusters. The book dissects the infrastructure, algorithms, and optimization strategies that enable large-scale language models to handle real-world workloads efficiently. Readers will gain a clear understanding of system design trade-offs, parallel computing techniques, and performance metrics critical for deploying production-grade LLM services.
